inputKind: a Vector of exact numbers (at least two, not all equal)

tasks.prompt: Leave the sum of the numbers, as a bare scalar.
Leave the arithmetic mean of the numbers, as a bare scalar.
Leave a Vector of each number minus the mean, in the original order.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V V 0 [ + ] FOLD V LENGTH / -

tasks.prompt: Leave the population variance (mean of squared deviations from the mean), as a bare scalar.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V V 0 [ + ] FOLD V LENGTH / - 'D' BIND D D * 0 [ + ] FOLD V LENGTH /

tasks.prompt: Leave the population standard deviation (square root of the population variance), as a bare scalar.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V V 0 [ + ] FOLD V LENGTH / - 'D' BIND D D * 0 [ + ] FOLD V LENGTH / SQRT

tasks.prompt: Leave the largest number minus the smallest, as a bare scalar.
tasks.reference: SORT 'S' BIND S -1 GET S 0 GET -

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector rescaling each number to (x - min) / (max - min), in the original order.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND V S 0 GET - S -1 GET S 0 GET - /
